model_selection: Inherited parent model; no override; independent reviewer agent, same OS user, not a protected holdout

findings.title: marker commit is not atomic create-new
findings.observed: Windows os.Rename(temp, existing) returned nil and replaced existing content. Production finalizer checks Lstat then invokes the same replacing primitive, leaving a check/use gap. This is a demonstrated primitive plus source-path proof; an orchestrated race of the complete finalizer was not claimed.
findings.impact: A marker created after Lstat can be overwritten, violating the explicit create-new/atomic-last requirement. Author concurrency caveat cannot satisfy this requirement.
findings.minimal_fix: Replace the marker commit with a Windows no-replace rename/move operation that fails if destination exists, preserve marker-last publication, and add an independent existing-destination/no-clobber test plus an injected or controlled race test. Keep temp and target on the same staged filesystem.

findings.title: builder output containment accepts dotdot escape
findings.observed: Path.absolute retained .local/../../escape-review; is_relative_to(worktree/.local) returned true, while resolve() placed it outside that .local. No escaped build/write was executed. Source also does not validate existing output-parent ancestors for reparse redirection; the latter is source review, not independently exercised builder-junction evidence.
findings.impact: The declared output-isolated-under-worktree-.local condition is bypassable by supplied path spelling; a build can create outputs outside its allowed root.
findings.minimal_fix: Reject noncanonical input paths and validate canonical resolved output/receipt containment against authorized roots before mkdir or any failure write. Validate every existing ancestor for Windows symlink/reparse redirection and reject source/output/receipts overlap. Add dotdot and junction-parent boundary cases within disposable test roots.

findings.title: failure handler writes into unowned preexisting receipts
findings.observed: An isolated directory containing sentinel.txt was supplied as --receipts. build refused with output and receipts must be create-new, exit 1, but the top-level except added failed.json to that already-existing directory.
findings.impact: Create-new refusal itself mutates a directory this invocation never acquired, violating preservation and receipt ownership.
findings.minimal_fix: Track receipt ownership only after successful create-new acquisition; write failure evidence only to that owned canonical directory. On early admission failure use stderr or an explicitly separate owned diagnostic destination. Add a preexisting-receipts snapshot test asserting no changes.
